スキャル.逐語: Scalping. Shorter periods like 5, 13, and 26 produce more signals, but also more false ones. They are best suited to 15-minute or even 5-minute charts.

The best Ichimoku settings for scalping and 1-minute chart are 12-24-120, where 12 is for the Conversion Line ( Tenkan-sen), 24 for the Base Line (Kyun-sen ), and 120 for the Leading Span B (Senkou Span B).

The best settings for the Ichimoku 5 min chart are standard default settings 9-26-52, where nine is for the Conversion Line ( Tenkan-sen), 26 for the Base Line (Kyun-sen ), and 52 for the Leading Span B (Senkou Span B).

デイトレ.逐語: Is the Ichimoku 15-minute strategy good for day trading? Yes, the Ichimoku 15-min strategy can work for day trading, but it calls for caution. Market noise leads to more false signals on lower time frames. Use faster settings (5, 13, 26) and confirm entries with the Chikou Span and trading volume.

その他の値.逐語: In crypto, some adapt to crypto-adjusted parameters like 10-30-60 because the market never sleeps. Still, most pros recommend learning the classic 9-26-52 first.

既定.出どころの質: 定番の教育サイト（TradingView ヘルプ）

既定.逐語: optInAcceleration real 0.02 ≥ 0 Step added to the acceleration factor on each new extreme point / optInMaximum real 0.2 ≥ 0 Ceiling on the acceleration factor
既定.出どころの質: ライブラリの説明（TA-Lib 公式）

既定.逐語: The initial factor is 0.02, the price step is also 0.02, and the maximum AF is 0.2. Most traders use these settings for the Parabolic. Wilder also used them.
既定.出どころの質: 証券会社（LiteFinance）の解説。開発者 Wilder の値として書く

スキャル.逐語: Adjust the settings to a Step of 0.01 and Maximum of 0.1 to optimize for scalping.

Scalping in the classic version, especially when it comes to trading on minute timeframes, requires the settings that are most sensitive to price changes. So it is best to set the largest value recommended by Wilder at 0.022.

For the M5 timeframe, I would stick to Wilder’s classic teachings and also use the Parabolic SAR setting with a step of 0.021 as the lowest price for the step. It is quite sensitive to fluctuations in five-minute charts. But the strategy using two Parabolics in a five-minute chart suggests adjusting one of the indicators in 0.04 increments.

デイトレ.逐語: The standard Parabolic SAR settings are quite applicable for classic intraday trading. In rare cases, when it comes to the timeframes M5 and M15 and the indicator needs higher sensitivity, the acceleration factor starts with a 0.021 step.

デイトレ.原文の足: 5分足・15分足（感度を上げたいとき）
デイトレ.逐語: In rare cases, when it comes to the timeframes M5 and M15 and the indicator needs higher sensitivity, the acceleration factor starts with a 0.021 step.

範囲.逐語: In practice, traders often adjust these parameters in the range from 0.018 to 0.021 for the step and from 0.018 to 0.021 for the maximum acceleration factor.
範囲.出どころの質: 証券会社（LiteFinance）の解説。maximum の範囲が既定 0.2 と桁が合わず、原文の誤りの可能性がある

その他の値.逐語: Chart 6 shows IBM with SAR (0.01, 0.20). The step is 0.01 and the Maximum Step is 0.20. Chart 7 shows IBM with a higher Step (0.03). SAR is more sensitive in chart 7 because there are more reversals.
その他の値.出どころの質: 定番の教育サイト（StockCharts ChartSchool）

メモ: 今のパラメータの組は空（[]）で、定義に書かれた 0.02 ずつ・0.2 で頭打ちは教科書の既定と同じ。

既定.逐語: optInTimePeriod integer 14 1–100000 Number of bars in the rolling sums
既定.出どころの質: ライブラリの説明（TA-Lib 公式）。出どころの違いを 'the only cross-source difference is the suggested period (14 vs Wikipedia's worked 21).' と書く

既定.逐語: +VM14 = 14-period Sum of +VM
既定.出どころの質: 定番の教育サイト（StockCharts ChartSchool）。計算の説明の値

既定.逐語: Most platforms provide this default at 14 and many traders prefer to leave it like that.
既定.出どころの質: ブログ（RealTrading）

範囲.逐語: Parameter length (n) is a result of trader preference. Traders commonly select parameters between 14 and 30 days.
範囲.出どころの質: 定番の教育サイト（TradingView ヘルプ）

範囲.値: 速くするなら 7〜10、上位の向きを見るなら 34〜55
範囲.逐語: Short periods like 7 to 10 are sometimes used for faster rotation, but they usually require stricter trade management because the lines can cross frequently in ranges. Longer periods like 34 to 55 are less common but can work as a higher timeframe regime filter, where you care more about staying aligned with the dominant direction than catching early turns.

その他の値.逐語: Decreasing the look-back period will increase sensitivity and result in more threshold crosses. For example, a daily chart with a 14-period VTX will be much more sensitive (volatile) than the 23-period version.
その他の値.出どころの質: 定番の教育サイト（StockCharts ChartSchool）

その他の値.値: スキャルは短く（値なし）
その他の値.条件: スタイル別だが値が無い
その他の値.逐語: For instance, a shorter period may be preferable for scalping, while a longer one can be better suited for position trading.

メモ: 今の値は 7・14・21 で、既定の 14 を含み、7 は TradingView の書く 14〜30 より短く trendsandbreakouts の書く 7〜10 に入る。
